_comment: Martyr Lifegain (2026-11-10), Lurrus of the Dream-Den: CAST LURRUS, THEN USE ITS PERMISSION IN THE SAME MAIN. 5 Plains (drop used), Serra Ascendant (not sick); Martyr of Sands in the GRAVEYARD; hand: Lurrus + two Ranger of Eos. Life 24, opponent 6. The only T4 kill: Lurrus ({1}{W/B}{W/B}), Martyr from the graveyard ({W}), activate it revealing the two Rangers ({1}, +6 -> 30): Serra 6/6 swings for 6. The graveyard cast did not exist when the plan started (no Lurrus) -- it is reachable only through the site-9 key a Lurrus CAST opens; the sacrifice through the recast Martyr's re-open.
